notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today. Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – removing microtransactions entirely - and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

New content includes:  

 Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
 New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
 New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
 New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
 Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
 Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.  


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078450/Warhammer_40000_Speed_Freeks/

notes.title: The Hotel Architect Demo is now live!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Our demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest. This is your chance to step into the shoes of a hotelier and design the ultimate guest experience. Whether you've been eagerly following the game's development or are just discovering it, the demo offers a hands-on preview of what it takes to build, manage, and customize a world-class hotel.  

For those new here: What is Hotel Architect & What should you expect in the Demo?  

Hotel Architect is a detailed hotel management simulation that allows you to craft unique and luxurious accommodations (or not... Your choice!). Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.  

In this demo, you can explore two stunning destinations: the bustling city of Gothenburg and the sun-soaked shores of Santorini. Each location presents unique challenges and opportunities, encouraging you to think strategically as you design and manage your properties.  

Key features of the demo include:  

 

 Scenario and Sandbox Modes - Tackle structured objectives or unleash your creativity in open-ended play.  
 Customizable Hotel Designs - Design every aspect of your hotel, from room layouts to décor  
 Diverse Guest Types - Cater to different guest profiles, each with unique needs and expectations. 
 Operational Challenges - Manage staffing, amenities, and services to keep guests happy and your business thriving.  

 


FAQ  

We also have a frequently asked questions post in the discussion area on steam so you can get help if needed. This will be a work in progress, but please check there before posting as it’ll help manage the flow of questions incoming during the demo!   


Content Creators playing Hotel Architect  

We also have a fantastic bunch of creators going live today and throughout Steam Next Fest, if you want to absorb more Hotel architect when you can't play yourself. Perhaps while working or travelling etc! Check out this list below:  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37644815/81fc235bcd2e99b627ed0c073d8b0a26713c6190.jpg  

Well Good Luck & get building!  

We can't for you to try it out, and let us know what you think!  

P.S. If you haven't already, there is also a giveaway happening for playing the demo! head to Wired.gg/HAgiveaway to be in with the chance of winning some epic Razer Tech worth of $350 and Hotel Architect goodies!

notes.title: Unlocking the Mystery: Our Top-Secret Project Revealed!
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen, gamers and thrill-seekers, gather 'round! The moment you’ve all been waiting for is finally here. After two years of clandestine development, late-night coding sessions, and more coffee than any sane person should consume, we’re ready to pull back the curtain on our latest creation. Buckle up, because this is going to be one wild ride!

We are delighted to reveal we are working with celebrated indie developers Just Add Water. 

Now, we know you’ve been wondering, “What’s this secret project all about?” Well, we’ve been as tight-lipped as a vault, but the wait is almost over. The game is like a locked treasure chest buried deep in the digital sands. The key? Your curiosity! 🔑

Wired Direct '24: The Grand Reveal:

Mark your calendars, set your alarms, and prepare to have your minds blown. On April 23rd, precisely at:
 12:00 PST
 15:00 EDT
 20:00 BSTWe’ll be revealing more at Wired Direct '24, streaming straight to your screens. 

Where to Watch:
Head over to wired.gg/WiredDirect to witness the magic unfold. Trust us; you won’t want to miss this. More links!

The Countdown Begins:
In the meantime, grab your favourite snacks, put on your lucky gaming socks, and join us as we embark on a brand-new adventure

Disclaimer: No actual secrets were harmed during the making of this blog post. But our excitement levels? Off the charts! 😜

notes.title: Wired Productions Summer Sale 2023
notes.content:
Phew! 

It is getting hot in here and we are all set for 2 weeks of fun in the sun. Yes, It’s the Wired Productions Summer Sale 2023. So, slather on the sun lotion and grab your costume and towel as we make a huge splash with some of our deepest discounts yet!

Tiny Troopers Joint Ops
is an epic bite-sized arcade shooter, filled to the brim with action-packed mini maps of mayhem!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225750/Tiny_Troopers_Joint_Ops_XL/

Tin Hearts
Embark on a series of lemmings-like puzzles to relive the heartwarming story of Albert Butterworth whilst guiding a troop of Tin Soldiers through a magical toy-filled world. Get ready to discover an immersive narrative puzzle adventure from the members of the team that brought you Fable.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831700/Tin_Hearts/

The Last Worker
The Last Worker is an immersive narrative adventure centred around a lone worker’s last stand in an increasingly automated world, with a unique blend of work simulation and stealth strategic gameplay. Fully PC VR supported.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579280/The_Last_Worker/

Tiny Troopers: Global Ops
Atennnnnshun! The Tiny Troopers are BACK in Global Ops, a fast-paced arcade twin-stick shooter. With a host of new features and an epic campaign featuring over 50 globe trotting missions, forces with up to four players in couch co-op or go online for full cross-platform play!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374350/Tiny_Troopers_Global_Ops/
